note: Coding profiles. Each profile says how to read and write one block of a module's coding data, plus 'recipes' that flip bits in it. A profile is used when its 'variant' matches the module's SGBD variant (shown in the module list) or its resolved SGBD name. Args: plain text is passed as text; 'hex:...' is sent as one binary argument. {data} is replaced with the coding bytes as hex. byte = offset into the data read, mask = which bits, on/off = the value of those bits. Only add recipes whose byte/mask you have confirmed for YOUR module variant from a coding guide - wrong values can disable features or the module.
